packages.name: Reclaim
packages.notes:
0.1.1-1578
- SDK/App/templates 0.15.2, CLI 0.15.4, UI 0.12.0; all three architectures.
- Custom UI colours and chart palettes use UI tokens.
- Includes parallel SPK builds, reproducibility verification and shared gate-image preservation.
- Known limitation: a cold rootfs report may exceed the CLI's 10-second synchronous request deadline.

packages.name: Download Hub
packages.notes:
